tool.name: Deunique.tree
tool.description: Reinsert the redundant sequence identiers back into a unique tree.
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$tree' tree.dat && ln -s '$names' names.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("tree=tree.dat") #silent $mothur_args.append("name=names.dat")
echo 'deunique.tree(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The deunique.tree_ command is the reinserts the redundant sequence identiers back into a unique tree using a name_ file.
.. _name: https://mothur.org/wiki/name_file/ .. _deunique.tree: https://mothur.org/wiki/deunique.tree/
